segments.name: Apparel SCM services
segments.description: Provides one-stop apparel supply chain management services, from design and sourcing to production and logistics, for apparel brands and retailers.
segments.evidence: We are a provider of SCM services in the apparel industry delivering one-stop solution to our customers for a broad range of yarn products, textiles and finished garments.

revenueModel.text: Customers including brand owners, textile manufacturers, apparel sourcing agents and online fashion and garment retailers pay for apparel supply chain services and products.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers span across different stages of the apparel supply chain, including brand owners, textile manufacturers, apparel sourcing agents and online fashion and garment retailers.
